description.value: Dead Frog Brewery is a Fraser Valley craft brewery that has been producing small-batch, unpasteurized beer for over 10 years, brewed just 50 feet from the tasting room taps. Their Langley tasting room pairs a rotating lineup of creative craft beers — from habanero hazy IPAs to peanut butter stouts — with a full food menu and a dog-friendly patio. Regular events including live music, themed brew competitions, and family-friendly afternoons make it a lively community stop in Langley's industrial corridor.

No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null; the OSM opening_hours tag reflects production/office hours that differ from the tasting room schedule on the website, which is flagged as a data quality concern.
